description: Land Acquistion -  Sinhapura, Ganga Ihala Korale D/S/D, Kandy District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific plot of land (Lot No. 01, Mariyawatta Estate) for a public water supply project. It provides detailed land descriptions, claimant particulars, boundaries, and procedures for compensation claims. This content falls squarely within the "Land Gazettes" (Type 4) category, which is defined for land and property-related matters such as land acquisitions, transfers, and registrations. It does not involve government personnel/structure changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized non-land categories (Types 5-9).
